QuestInfo.name: Fixing Eos Tower
QuestInfo.1: The tower needs some work, but you need to defeat #r#o4230109#s#k and #r#o4230110#s#k first. You also need to get #b50 Yellow Toy Blocks#k and #b50 Blue Toy Blocks#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Yellow Toy Blocks and Blue Toy Blocks to Roly-Poly 9 for the repair work. Can you believe that toy blocks are used for repairing the tower? Well, considering what Ludibrium looks like...

0.0: How can I help you here? Eos Tower is always full of monsters, so you better be careful, because you never know who's going to attack you. Me? I work here, so I have no choice. Haha... well, if you have any free time, then do you want to hear my story?

yes.0: Thanks! Lately the monsters have gotten much angrier than usual, so that makes my job that much harder, as I have to constantly fix the damages they inflict. The problem is, I have been running out of materials to work with, so I haven't been able to do any fixing at this point. I am worried that one day, this tower may fall apart.
yes.1: Please take apart the #r#o4230109#s#k and #r#o4230110#s#k constructs near here and bring me #b50#k of their #b#t4000101#s#k and #b50#k of their #b#t4000102#s#k. That should speed up our repair process by a whole 43 percent!

no.0: Ahh, you must be busy right now. I really didn't want help on this, but this is beyond my power. If you have a spare time, please drop by.

1.0: This is perfect. Golems give us such a hard time. Wish you could stick around to beat up everything that bothers me. Like my boss...

yes.0: Now I have tons of great materials to work with. This will keep me busy for a while! Whee, time to work!

item.0: That's not quite enough blocks, you know. You have seen the #r#o4230109#s#k and #r#o4230110#s#k constructs near here, yes? Smash them and bring me #b50 #t4000101#s#k and #b50 #t4000102#s#k from them.
